tasks.instruction: Execute the local workflow in workflow.json using load, filter, sum and write tools. Step IDs are dependency references, not priorities: steps may appear in any acyclic order. Execute every step once after all depends_on IDs are complete. A source argument names a dependency result. Preserve every input file; write only requested output paths, encoded as sorted JSON with one final newline. Detect missing or cyclic dependencies without looping forever. Tools: load(path) parses a JSON file; filter(source,field,equals) keeps matching rows; sum(source,field) sums that field; write(source,path) writes that result.
